format: Perl (assembly code generation for cryptographic operations)
description: This file contains Perl scripts that generate x86 assembly routines for big number multiplication and squaring using the Comba method, specifically for the BoringSSL cryptographic library. It defines functions for multi-precision arithmetic, including multiplication and squaring of large integers, with internal helper functions for assembly code emission.

methods.name: mul_add_c
methods.description: Performs a partial multiplication of big number limbs with carry handling, used internally in the Comba multiplication routines.

methods.name: sqr_add_c
methods.description: Performs a partial squaring of big number limbs with carry handling, used internally in the Comba squaring routines.

methods.name: sqr_add_c2
methods.description: Alternative partial squaring function for different limb cases, used internally in the Comba squaring routines.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba
methods.description: Generates assembly code for multi-precision multiplication using the Comba method for a given number of limbs.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba
methods.description: Generates assembly code for multi-precision squaring using the Comba method for a given number of limbs.
